description: List the approved members of this workspace — uid, name, email, role and whether they can be assigned work — so a person can be named in assigneeUid (anyforge_update_work_item action assign/begin, anyforge_create_work_item) or assignedOperatorId (initiatives). Those fields take the uid, never an email. `q` narrows by name, part of a name, email or uid; several people can match, so confirm which before assigning. `assignable` is false for viewer and filer roles, which the assign write refuses. Only this workspace's own members are listed; people removed from it, pending approval, or hidden are not. ONE PAGE per call (50 by default, 100 max): when `meta.hasMore` is true pass `meta.nextCursor` back as `cursor` with the same `q`. Requires `read` scope.

cursor.description: meta.nextCursor from the previous page. Only valid with the same q.

q.description: Name, part of a name, email or uid to look for.

name: anyforge_list_members
title: List members
